name: Thomas Campbell
abstract_title:
Reality is Consciousness

Challenging materialist reductionism, this presentation argues consciousness is fundamental to our existence, distinct from the brain, and the primary driver of reality.
abstract: Abstract: Consciousness as Fundamental—Deriving the Physical from the Subjective The "Hard Problem" of consciousness—how subjective feeling arises from insentient matter—remains insoluble under the current materialist paradigm because the fundamental assumption is flawed. We propose a radical inversion of this causality: consciousness is not a product of the brain; rather, the brain and the physical universe are products of consciousness.
